Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add:
Owners: package README/docs and ZAQ dependency/configuration/docs. Document explicit package infrastructure child/init options separately from per-connection upstream composite storage and host callbacks, with prepare/seed readiness ordering, strict RAM-only vs coexistence, node-local data lifetime and resource ownership. Show the complete flow: Amarula callbacks -> upstream composite storage with ZAQ authorization/durable callbacks -> encrypted Connect database for paired/supporting state, or package Mnesia for session/sender_key. Explain dependency-started Mnesia vs configured package tables; immutable option changes require replacing the infrastructure generation. Document compatibility with automatic Amarula startup and start_runtime:false; no replicated/quorum mode is introduced. Audit all callers and remove obsolete local-store references. Prepare package release/PR and ZAQ integration handoff with exact tested revision; production pin changes wait until revision is available remotely under separately authorized publishing. Stop affected listeners during deployment: no live copy or dual-write migration of volatile protocol state. Preserve encrypted pairing; explicitly document cold RAM state and possible message decryption interruption on rollout/rollback. Reconcile zaq-0l7.22 only after its regression is proved; do not close on planning alone.

Tests to add before implementation:
Before release changes, define dependency compatibility smoke checks for old default File/custom consumers, DETS and opt-in Mnesia; clean dependency resolution against the eventual pinned revision. Verify docs examples against compiled API and distinguish existing live tests from non-live checks.

Branches/paths validated:
Local path development vs production git dependency; new package with old host; migrated host with matching package; unavailable revision; rollout and rollback requiring listener stop.

Mocking plan:
Use real internal storage, transactions, supervision and host boundaries. Inject fake WhatsApp network transport only at external provider boundary; isolated BEAMs for VM-wide Mnesia state. Configuration resolved at public boundaries; ZAQ runtime config uses Zaq.Config per policy.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/ related content:
Package README/docs/adapter_contracts and ZAQ docs/services/channels.md/system-config.md; no generated CHANGELOG edits. Read docs/documentation.md and index before documentation changes.

Action reuse assessment:
Not applicable to documentation/release metadata operations; reuse existing Mix dependency mechanism. No new runtime Actions or automatic publication. Release authorization remains separate from plan approval.

Validation and E2E:
Follow docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md and docs/testing-approach.md; package follows its own quality gate. No new UI or user journey: no new E2E authoring required. Implementation must preserve existing assertions and include property tests for isolation/idempotence/capacity invariants.

Reference web_widget as design evidence, not a runtime dependency. Explain that adding the explicit infrastructure child is a host integration change; table lifecycle remains package implementation. Existing File/DETS/custom storage clients retain compatibility and do not need Mnesia infrastructure unless they select it.

ZAQ keeps only thin authorization/encrypted-persistence/connector callbacks in existing responsibility-compatible facades. Preserve this step's existing backend, lifecycle, rollout and validation requirements. New prerequisite issues cover the additional package and host API work. Document standalone non-ZAQ use, all typed callback contracts, preserved encrypted-record format and removal of the old directory. Package revision must be available before production dependency pinning; rollout/rollback stops provisional and saved listeners, preserves encrypted pairing and permits fresh RAM sessions. No release or git mutation without separate authorization.
